preview_heading: Falcons meet Tridents in North Sound
preview: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons face Barbados Tridents in CPL 2026 Match 16 at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium. The match is scheduled for Tue 25 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The Falcons bring Antiguan fast bowler Alzarri Joseph home for 2026 and add Evin Lewis to a returning core that includes Fabian Allen, Jayden Seales and Amir Jangoo. Barbados return to the Tridents identity and national colours in 2026, with Gudakesh Motie, Sherfane Rutherford and Brandon King among the senior Caribbean core. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
